title: ffjet: a semi-analytic force-free jet model for images and spectral energy distributions
description: ffjet is a Python implementation of the semi-analytic force-free jet model of Tsunetoe et al. (2025): an axisymmetric force-free jet in the Kerr spacetime, supplemented with a prescription for nonthermal electron heating, synchrotron cooling, and pitch-angle anisotropy in the electron distribution, with radiative transfer along straight rays. It computes model images and spectral energy distributions of relativistic jets. This release is the version used in Pesce, Narayan & Tsunetoe, "A model for the image structure and spectral energy distribution of relativistic jets".
